en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a view framed by three large arched columns, looking out over a broad piazza with a central baroque fountain and surrounding historic buildings. A church bell tower and another tower rise above the rooftops, and mountains are visible in the distant background. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the scene as Trento and Piaz(z)a Vittorio Emanuele III, seen from the Duomo.
